text: At start, the orange hint 'The NEXT line ... says what comes next' is drawn over the help line 'W A S D walk Shift hurry Mouse look E use', both unreadable where they overlap

The potter's wheel reads as a flat dark disc on the ground (looked like a shadow); NEXT said '3 m ahead' while I stood beside it, and I had to look down and walk onto it before the wheel prompt appeared
With HUD shown at the wheel, the wheel prompt '1 water jar 2 bowl 3 cup 4 lamp' is centered over the CHORES list and MADE header, wrapping '4 lamp' onto the MADE line

Clay lens (C): world goes dark umber with dust motes, the three pots sit in a row on the ground 3 m behind the wheel and glow; the MADE list now reads 'Ganga: clay' etc. Evocative. But the pots spawn behind the player at the wheel, so I only found them via the NEXT distance hint

Breaking the Ganga pot opened codex page 'The space in the pot' (Gaudapada, Mandukya Karika 3.3-3.4) with Devanagari, transliteration, translation and a note tying it to my broken pot. Lovely. Minor: left-hand page list truncates the title to 'The space in the pot' running into the page edge

Codex 'Other schools: that you are' presents Advaita, Vishishtadvaita and Dvaita readings of tat tvam asi even-handedly and says the game takes the Advaita reading as one school's reading. Good. At 640x360 the body text of codex pages is very small (roughly 6-7 px glyphs), hard to read

On the ghat steps, NEXT says 'Wait on the ghat steps for the sunset' with no sense of how long; E on the steps gave no feedback (no 'fill' prompt, no message) though the chore says 'Water from the ghat to the potter'. pt wait 20 = 20 game minutes and took ~3 min wall-clock on the shared machine

After lighting the lamp (F) and holding it on the coiled snake on the dusk path for a few seconds, it became a pale rope, Fear dropped from full to half and a new codex page opened. Text issue: NEXT line 'Go closer with the lamp, then look at it steadily (1' is cut off at the right edge of the screen
